snippet.title: Bolt of Whalington | Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Free playable demo OUT now!!!

Play it on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3535270

What if a Metroidvania game can let you change the rule?
Bolt of Whalington is a Metroidvania built around discovery and curiosity. Play as Bolt, a Siamese cat exploring a flying castle where you might melt walls with soap, become a rat to talk to enemies, or even rewrite the world’s rules. Explore, experiment, and uncover Whalington’s secrets. Curiosity doesn’t kill this cat!
